findings: Fermat/Euler correctness conflated with confidentiality and all modern protocols;unjustified historical/LINE/Amazon universality.
Carmichael all-a wording omits gcd;Fermat repeat-pass confidence claim lacks universal bound,MillerRabin probability needs independent uniform bases and finite-round limits.
Flowchart lacks smalln/nonpositive-round guards,initializes i implicitly,and omits the relevant test outcome distinction.
Signed __int128 multiplication can overflow for uint64 operands;extension portability and m=1/zero-exponent case missing.
Python/C++ nonpositive iterations accept9;MersenneTwister is not a cryptographic prime generator.
Toy generate_prime can return composite1105;actual forced composite key fails roundtrip. e=1 is allowed;message representatives are not range-checked;key tuple order differs between prose and code.
RSA proof needs explicit all-representative CRT treatment,not probability dismissal;raw character-wise deterministic RSA is not secure encryption.
English Crypto substring links point into cryptocurrency,and Euclide substring link points to Japanese biography rather than algorithm.
